exposure: Pregnancies with elevated IGF-1 levels, pregnancies with normalized IGF-1 levels
outcome: Maternal complications (e.g., arterial hypertension worsening, impairment of glucose levels)
finding: Acromegaly during pregnancy was associated with a higher risk of maternal complications, particularly worsening arterial hypertension and impaired glucose levels, but not with adverse neonatal outcomes except for a few cases of congenital malformations and fetal macrosomia.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was performed in sixteen out of the 31 pregnancies in women with acromegaly.
